title: Family sues racket maker after 2024 death of 6-year-old daughter in Maine
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Local News Lucy Morgan, 6, died after being impaled by a Franklin Sports racket that broke during normal use, her family says.
The family of a 6-year-old killed in 2024 when a badminton racket malfunctioned filed a wrongful death lawsuit on Tuesday against the company that sold the racket.

On June 1, 2024, the older siblings of 6-year-old Lucy Morgan were playing badminton at a vacation home in Limerick, Maine when the racket broke and fatally struck Morgan, the law firm Berman & Simmons said in a press release.
